tools.name: getMe
tools.description: Who am I, what plan am I on, and what credits do I have. Requires scope: read_usage.

tools.name: listItems
tools.description: List the account's items (newest first, cursor-paginated). Query: limit (1–100, default 25), cursor (created_at ISO string from next_cursor), status. Requires scope: read_catalog.

tools.name: createItem
tools.description: Create an item from 1–4 image URLs and start analysis. Images are fetched server-side (https only, size- and type-checked against the active provider's limits). tools.name: getItem
tools.description: Get one item, including status and next_allowed_actions. Requires scope: read_catalog.

tools.name: updateItem
tools.description: Update the item's public-page settings (product CTA link). Sets the 'view product' button shown on the public AR page and embeds. product_url must be a public https URL on your own site, and it may not point at pixeloa.ai itself or a private network (422 validation_error otherwise). tools.name: deleteItem
tools.description: Delete an item (unpublishes first; removes images and models). Permanent. A published item is unpublished first so its AR page and embeds go quiet, then its images, models and QR are removed. Requires the same scope as creating items. CHANGES PUBLIC STATE. Requires scope: upload_images.

tools.name: confirmScale
tools.description: Confirm the item's real-world dimensions (cm). Allowed once analysis has finished (status 'awaiting_confirmation', or 'failed' with a completed analysis) and before generation. Moves the item to 'confirmed'. Requires scope: confirm_scale.

tools.name: startGeneration
tools.description: Start 3D generation (spends the account's credits). Requires status 'confirmed' with confirmed dimensions (a 'failed' generation may be attempted again on the same item; it was refunded and has no result). tools.name: unpublishItem
tools.description: Unpublish the item's public AR page (all embeds go quiet). CHANGES PUBLIC STATE. Requires scope: publish_items.

tools.name: getItemLinks
tools.description: Public AR URL, embed URL, embed snippets and QR (if generated). Requires scope: read_catalog.

tools.name: generateItemQr
tools.description: Generate (or regenerate) the item's QR code SVG. Requires scope: create_qr.

tools.name: listCatalogs
tools.description: List the account's catalogs. Requires scope: read_catalog.

tools.name: deleteCatalog
tools.description: Delete a catalog (unpublishes its public page first). Permanent. A published catalog is unpublished first so its public page, QR and embeds go quiet; item memberships are removed (the items themselves are untouched); if it was the primary catalog that pointer clears. tools.name: addCatalogItem
tools.description: Add an item to a catalog (appends unless position is given). Both the catalog and the item must belong to the key's account (404 otherwise). 409 conflict when the item is not ready (details.status says where it is), is not eligible for catalogs, is unlisted (link only), or is already in the catalog.

tools.name: removeCatalogItem
tools.description: Remove an item from a catalog. Requires scope: write_catalog.

tools.name: listGenerationOptions
tools.description: Generation options available to this account and their current credit cost. Read before spending. Each option lists credit_cost (what POST /v1/items/{id}/generate will debit for that provider), release_stage, image limits and output formats; is_default marks the provider used when the item has none

tools.name: listCreditLedger
tools.description: The account's credit ledger (newest first, cursor-paginated). Every debit and credit: generation charges, refunds, plan allocations, top-ups. Query: limit (1–100), cursor (created_at from next_cursor). Requires scope: read_usage.

tools.name: listAgents
tools.description: List the account's agent identities. An agent is an identity OWNED by the account (kind agent or service). Keys attach to an agent; the agent gets actor identity, an optional daily credit cap and its own audit trail, but every call still runs as the owner. Agents are created and suspended by a human

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "publishItem" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Publish the item's public AR page. Makes the item public (this is the owner's publish decision; items created via the API start private) subject to the plan's p…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "listWebhookEndpoints" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the account's webhook endpoints and the event types. Endpoints are created by a human in the dashboard (Account → API keys → Webhooks); a key can list them…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: createItem, updateItem, listGenerationOptions · Private data: updateItem, publishItem, listWebhookEndpoints · Public sink: publishItem, listGenerationOptions, listWebhookEndpoints · Destructive: deleteItem, deleteCatalog, removeCatalogItem.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: createItem, updateItem, listGenerationOptions · Private data: updateItem, publishItem, listWebhookEndpoints · Public sink: publishItem, listGenerationOptions, listWebhookEndpoints · Destructive: deleteItem, deleteCatalog, removeCatalogItem

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
